findings.title: Incorrect argument order in URLSafeTimedSerializer call
findings.body: The new code passes `keys` as the first positional argument to `URLSafeTimedSerializer`, but the old code passed `app.secret_key` as the first positional argument and `signer_kwargs` as a keyword argument. This breaks the expected signature and will likely cause a runtime error when the serializer is used.

findings.title: Unnecessary nested signer_kwargs dictionary
findings.body: The new code nests the `signer_kwargs` dictionary inside another dictionary, which is incorrect. The `signer_kwargs` should be passed directly as a keyword argument to `URLSafeTimedSerializer`, not wrapped in an additional dictionary. This will cause a runtime error due to an unexpected keyword argument.

summary.problem: The changes to support secret key rotation introduce incorrect argument passing to `URLSafeTimedSerializer`, breaking the expected signature and causing potential runtime errors.
summary.done_well: The implementation correctly collects fallback keys from the app configuration and prepares them for use in session serialization.
